reading.body:
Google does not publish power capacity, square footage, or building-level specifications for its individual data center facilities. This campus in the Atlanta metro area is therefore not quantifiable from disclosed information, and its capacity cannot be compared to other sites.

Georgia has 33 mapped data center facilities statewide, but only 4 publish power capacity figures. Those four facilities account for 66.3 MW of published IT load. This campus, unspecified in power terms, ranks fifth in the state by capacity estimation methods this site does not employ.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be evaluated for relevance to AI infrastructure scaling. The coordinate record appears corrupted and resolves to a restaurant in Atlanta rather than a data center location. Researchers tracking grid constraints on AI compute require operators to publish facility-level power and capacity data, which Google does not do at individual building granularity.
